support.text:
Facts:
Hiroshi and Soraya Tanaka (hereinafter the Debtors) filed for bankruptcy on 6/3/2024. The beige 1995 Toyota Camry LE (168,000 miles) belonging to Hiroshi and Soraya has an appraisal value of $2,200.00. A disclosure of assets by the Debtors reports a professional-grade treadmill with touchscreen display and live training programs with a current value of $2,790.00. Both a handheld garment steamer with fast heat-up time worth $180.00 and a beige suede hoodie with removable liner with a value of $63.00 belong to the Tanakas.
